title: Compact steps table placed for reading
goal: The steps table reads at a glance: step, remaining days, status; the long dated basis moves into the record details
acceptance: The table shows step, remaining (number and size), baseline and status; the basis text moves to a generated list inside `<details>`
The table stays immediately after the Issue/Reproduce/Check table and before `<details>` (or above it, per the owner's choice)
The table is inserted at the record's own details block, not at the first literal `<details>` in its text (today a record that mentions the tag in its Issue or Check gets the table inside that cell)
privacy: Metadata only: estimates, dates, durations and task identities; no prompts, transcripts or personal data.
validation: Fixtures for the rendered table and details list
escalation: Placement above or below the Issue/Reproduce/Check table is an owner choice

effort.basis: Rendering-only change in featurePlan(). Estimate, not a measurement.
